summary: A disabled-by-default nonpublic operator safely expires one explicitly identified never-dispatched reservation through the existing database RPC. It never enumerates customers or releases ambiguous supplier liabilities.
existing_authority: Original API WILD Supabase project; service-role-only public.apiwild_gateway_expire(text,uuid,bigint). Existing SQL locks and exact owner/state/version/expiry checks remain authoritative. No new migration.
limitations: No external write, production cleanup, secret inspection, paid provider call, scheduled sweep or customer enumeration performed by this worker.
Execution requires an explicitly verified owner/request/current version, original project server credential, and APIWILD_RESERVATION_EXPIRY_ENABLED=true. Local --check makes no network request.
Timeout or unknown response can follow a committed cancellation; operator reports unconfirmed and never retries automatically.
Executing, uncertain and settled supplier-pending work remain held; actual-CNY receipt access is still an independent external acceptance gate.
PGlite tests use one isolated in-memory database connection, not independent production transaction concurrency.
Container packaging is owned by the other worker and independently reviewed by /root/source_launch_audit; evidence apiwild-expiry-packaging-review.json.
